title: Approvals: the note for a position with no approver still shows the position's internal name
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up from #35418 (PR #36030, the seat's declaration L2 record 7060479330, nit N2). Under epic #34571.

## What PR #36030 leaves

PR #36030 makes a routing note name an unstaffed position by its label: the reader's language pack, then the position's declared label, then the internal name. The **no-approver** note is not covered. Its "who" part is stored as a finished string when the note is written, so a reader still sees the internal position name (for example `regional_manager`) instead of its label.

## To do

1. Store the no-approver note's position as a reference, not a finished string, so the read can name it the same way the other routing notes are named in #36030.
2. Keep the stored audit text unchanged for notes already written; only the shown text changes.
3. Pin it: a no-approver note for a position with a declared label shows the label in the reader's language, and falls back to the internal name when no label exists.

## Acceptance

- A reader in any of the eleven languages sees the position's label in the no-approver note, never the internal name, when the position declares one.

Blocked-by: #36030
